title: Cost-Effective Hydrogen Storage Materials: Utilizing Biogas Slurry to Synthesize High-Performance Hollow porous Carbon Spheres
material_description: CS850-4.5 | KOH-activated hollow porous carbon spheres from biogas slurry, starch and alpha-Fe2O3 (hydrothermal carbonization 200 C, carbonization 800 C, HCl wash), KOH:CS 4.5, 850 C
purification_method: Washed with deionized water, 1 mol/L HCl and ethanol until filtrate clear (after carbonization at 800 C)
activation_method: KOH impregnation activation, KOH-to-CS mass ratio 4.5, 850 C, 2 h, N2
source_location: main.pdf p.4, Table 2 (H2 uptake wt%, 1 bar), Sec. 3.4; Fig. 4a same sample
notes: Basis not named for this value; gravimetric instrument with no stated buoyancy correction.
